header: scripts/eds-gold-keys.ts: my GOLD test of the EDS engine. Each question has an answer KEY written from the circular's own text (checked against the stored text of 9 Nov 2026): the facts a correct answer MUST contain (a fact is found when any one of its patterns matches the normalised answer) and the statements it must NOT make. Normalisation (see eds-gold.ts): lower case; thousands commas removed; "24th" -> "24"; "Rs." / "₹" -> "rs".
